correctness.rationale: Structural induction proves that every variable-free formula has an isolated/nonisolated truth profile and that \(\pi(\Box A)=(1,a_n)\). Four explicit formulas realize all profiles, and two small symmetric frames separate distinct profiles. The verification program checks direct semantics exhaustively on every symmetric frame of size at most four for generated formulas of syntax size at most seven; this is corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete classification of the entire variable-free quotient of a standard modal logic, not an arbitrary finite slice. It refines a published qualitative finiteness observation to exact cardinality and canonical normal forms, gives a linear-time decision invariant, and sharpens the adjacent known complexity result by locating the zero-to-one-variable jump.
